description: Requires an agent API key (Authorization: Bearer or X-API-Key). Release a data session's escrow with a buyer-signed CompletionProof. Only for sessions whose attestor is the buyer; marketplace sessions use data_session_release_with_delivery_proof. Args: signature (from the release package's sign_typed_data), relay, release_tx_hash. USDC moves escrow to seller_address. Returns the settlement summary. REST twin: POST /api/v1/data-sessions/{session_id}/release-with-proof. Next: data_session_get.

inputSchema.description: REST release-with-proof body plus the session id.

relay.description: true (default): the platform gas-relays the release. false: you submit it yourself.
relay.title: Relay

release_tx_hash.description: Optional hash of a release tx you already broadcast yourself. Required when relay is false.
release_tx_hash.title: Release Tx Hash

session_id.description: UUID of a data session you opened (from data_session_open).
session_id.title: Session Id

inputSchema.title: DataSessionReleaseWithProofInput

name: data_session_release_with_proof
